annotation.contextual_rationale: This video is scam content because it promotes its own crypto arbitrage bot as an easy, risk-free source of passive income and claims a return of about $1,500 after one week. It directs viewers to deploy the contract, fund it with BNB, and start it, while showing the transaction workflow and an unverified balance increase.
annotation.fine_grained_rationale: The central mechanism is a crypto arbitrage bot linked to profit claims and a workflow involving contract deployment, BNB funding, and bot activation. The speaker explicitly describes funding the contract and starting it, then reports a weekly profit result.
